Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Curved Vintage-Look Wood Frame Wall Mirror - 28-Inch Height, White
Colors: White
Materials: wood
Straight lines are paired with graceful curves that peak at the top on this antique-style mirror. Distressed white paint on a hardwood frame adds more vintage charm. This mirror will look right at home in a classic style room. Antique-style shape and finish Made of glass and hardwood with distressed white finish 16"W x 1"D x 28"H Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware not included.
